strategy.blue_green: Blue-green: switch traffic after health check

deployKey.title: Deploy key
deployKey.description: Add this public key to the repository as a read-only deploy key. The private half stays encrypted on the server and is never shown.

delete.title: Delete this application
delete.description: Removes the application and its settings. This cannot be undone.

deployments.title: Deployments
deployments.description: Each deployment builds or pulls the source and replaces the running container once it is ready.
deployments.empty: Nothing deployed yet. Deploy to start the first container.
deployments.logUnavailable: The log could not be loaded. Retrying…

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Route a host name to this application. HTTPS certificates come from Let's Encrypt and plain HTTP is redirected.
domains.empty: No domains yet. The application is reachable only inside the server network.
domains.portHint: The port your app listens on inside the container.
domains.proxyDisabled: This server runs FerroDock without its own proxy, so domains are saved but not routed. Reinstall with FERRODOCK_PROXY=traefik when ports 80 and 443 are free.

verdictHint.points_here: Traffic will reach this server and the certificate can be issued.
verdictHint.proxied: Cloudflare proxies this record. Keep SSL mode at Full (strict) so the certificate challenge can pass.
verdictHint.unverified: The record resolves, but this server's public address is not configured to compare.
verdictHint.points_elsewhere: The record points to another address. Update the A or AAAA record before expecting HTTPS.
verdictHint.unresolved: No A or AAAA record yet. Create one that points to this server.

domains.serviceHint: The service name from your compose file.
domains.authUserInvalid: Use up to 64 characters without spaces or colons.
domains.authPasswordHint: 8 to 72 characters. Only a bcrypt hash is stored.

variables.title: Environment variables
variables.description: Encrypted at rest and passed to the container and to Docker Compose. Changes apply on the next deployment.
variables.secret: Secret: hide the value after saving
variables.hiddenKept: {{count}} secret values are not shown here and stay unchanged unless you list the same name.
variables.invalidLines: Skipped lines that are not NAME=value: {{lines}}

terminal.unavailable: Start a deployment first; the terminal needs a running container.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Live output of the running container. The last 300 lines load first and new lines stream in as they are written.
logs.empty: No containers yet. Deploy the application to see its logs.
logs.closed: The log stream ended. The container stopped or was replaced.
